papers.title: Dynamics of the Transformer Residual Stream: Coupling Spectral Geometry to Network Topology
papers.use: Separate branch from identity/residual map; singular-value gain, polar factors, asymmetry and non-normality measure different properties.
papers.limits: Isolated single-token position0 attention with no KV cache; eigenvalues/compositions largely use mean Jacobians. Cannot substitute for actual full-prefix cached trajectories. Companion code redacted for review in A.6.

papers.title: Recurrent Self-Attention Dynamics: An Energy-Agnostic Perspective from Jacobians
papers.methods_read: Energy-agnostic motivation, Jacobian/pseudo-energy analysis and discussion limits
papers.use: Allow oscillatory and non-gradient dynamics. An energy-like summary need not be a Lyapunov function.
papers.limits: Recurrent SA omits positional encoding, masks and MLP. Its linked AKOrN implementation addresses that idealized architecture, not Qwen's native cached path.

papers.title: Transformer Field Theory: A Response-Theoretic Approach to Mechanistic Interpretability
papers.methods_read: Local linearity/superposition, sensitivity predictions and empirical GPT-2 setup
papers.use: Freeze signed strength sweeps, predict before measuring, test unnormalized direction sums and report weak-denominator artifacts.
papers.limits: Bounded GPT-2/local response evidence, not a universal field law or transfer to Qwen/27B; no runnable implementation link found in the accessed article.

papers.title: FishBack: Pullback Fisher Geometry for Optimal Activation Steering in Transformers
papers.methods_read: Sections3/4 and appendicesE/F numerical approximation/cost limits
papers.use: For actual model logit derivative q and base distribution p, local KL cost is epsilon^2/2 times Var_p(q); no covariance fit or full Fisher matrix required for a directional test.
papers.limits: Local fixed-context output cost. It is neither conserved/physical energy nor a generic steering detector. Published large-model approximation freezes a Jacobian and truncates Fisher modes; our pilot uses full-vocabulary directional derivatives at each actual base context.

mathematical_lead: For d+=o+e and d-=e-o, d+ dot d-=||e||^2-||o||^2. Opposite linear responses have e=0; comparable odd/even energy produces an approximately right angle. Test where e originates rather than calling that angle linear rotation.
